published_ranges._nozzle_by_speed: 220C @ 6 mm3/s; 240C @ 12 mm3/s (Material Data Table, Bambu); 206C @ 2-3 mm3/s, 25-45 mm/s (Translucent/Sparkly TDS, Ultimaker S5 profile)
published_ranges._notes: Melt point (Tm) onset approx. 155C. TDS: theoretical HDT >140C after heat treating. Material Data Table row 'PLAs (w/o fibers)' covers PLA1/HTP2/HTP3/HTPM/HTGL etc. and recommends the Generic PLA profile; replace tubing more often with rough filament. Blog (EX15/EL43): start from Generic PLA, raise nozzle 220->240 for HTPLA colours, 55C plate, max 12 mm3/s, 100% layer fan, aux fan off. fields low/high are the two Material Data Table points.
published_ranges._drying: Protopasta does not recommend drying its PLA-based materials (QD HTPLA TDS)

conflicts: Density: 1.2 g/cc in the PLA/HTPLA Colors SDS (https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/0717/9095/files/PLA_Colors.pdf) vs approx. 1.24 g/cc in the Translucent/Sparkly TDS
